paragraphs: Yehoshua: Rabbi Yochanan ben Yehoshua; Rabbi Yose ben Yehoshua; Rabbi Yishmael ben Yehoshua; Rabbi Shimon ben Yehoshua. [Glosses: Yehoshua. (1) Niddah 25a and 69b: ‘Rabbi Yehoshua ben Chanina’; in the new Talmud edition, Chananya. Arakhin 11b should read Chananyah; it was not corrected. (2) Shabbat 147a: ‘Rabbi Yehoshua ben Kefusai’; Bekhorot 39a has Kefutzai, while most places have Kefusai. It was not corrected. (3) Nazir 59b, Rashi, the comment beginning ‘VeLeita,’ and so forth: ‘What answer did Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi give Ben Zoma?’ ‘Ben Levi’ is a scribal error, for an unqualified Rabbi Yehoshua is ben Chananyah, as Rashi writes there, 56b; Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi lived several generations later. (4) Yoma 64: ‘Hoshea Uzaa’ should read ‘Yehoshua.’ (5) Zevachim 32b: ‘Rav Yehoshua raised an objection to Ulla’; perhaps this is Rav Yehoshua bar Abba. The new Talmud edition has ‘Rav Hoshaya.’]
